source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: instructions PDF page 7, code 02E; Schedule E Lines 1, 3, 4A to 4H, 5 (Form IT-540 PDF page 8; instructions PDF pages 6, 7 and 10); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 20,000.00 + Louisiana State Employees' Retirement System pension (person 0) 40,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 44,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. Schedule E: Line 1 federal AGI 60,000.00. Line 3 total = 60,000.00. Exempt income: code 02E Louisiana State Employees' Retirement System pension 40,000.00. Line 4H = 40,000.00. Line 5 Louisiana AGI = 60,000.00 - 40,000.00 = 20,000.00. IT-540 Line 7 (from Schedule E Line 5) 20,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 20,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 7,500.00. Line 11 = 7,500.00 x .03 = 225.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 225.00. Code 02E has no age test, income test or cap: the whole benefit is exempt at 62.
accepted_approximations: Every public_pension is treated as exempt. Louisiana exempts only its listed systems (codes 02E, 03E, 05E) and federal retirement systems (code 04E); a Louisiana government pension from a system not on the list would fall in the 12,000 exemption instead.
